question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Blunt
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Insensitive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"blunt"** means straightforward and direct in speech or manner, often to the point of being rude or insensitive. (स्पष्टवादी, मुंहफट)

 
 
• **Example: **His blunt comments about her performance were hurtful but true.
 
 
 
• **"Insensitive" **refers to someone who is not aware of or does not care about other people's feelings. (संवेदनहीन)
 
 
• **Example: **His insensitive remarks about the accident shocked everyone.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'blunt' **is **'insensitive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Insensitive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Adventurous **(साहसी): Willing to take risks or try out new methods, ideas, or experiences.

 
 
• **Example:** She had always wanted to lead a more adventurous life, full of travel and excitement.
 
 
 
• **Tactful **(कुशल): Having or showing skill and sensitivity in dealing with others or with difficult issues.
 
 
• **Example: **He handled the criticism in a very tactful manner.
 
 
 
• **Rowdy** (शोरगुल): Noisy and disorderly.
 
 
• **Example:** The rowdy crowd was hard to control after the concert.
